$description: Single-page vertical document. One continuous surface, consistent width.

surround.rule: The document floats as a card on a lighter neutral surround. Surround color must come from the token palette.

background.rule: Dark-light-dark sandwich. Header opens with the brand's dark surface for impact. Content sections use light surface for readability. Closing returns to dark to bookend.

break.whitespace: sectionGap / 2 above and below the line
break.rule: Equal whitespace above and below the divider line. The line sits in the middle. That's it.

width.rule: Every element shares the same content width and side padding. No exceptions. Header content, body content, footer content — all aligned.

responsive.rule: Same layout on mobile. Only padding reduces. No reflow.
